Dialog.ProfileHint: Save the profile to find and reuse access to the server.
Dialog.Name: VPS or server name
Dialog.SshDescription: Terminal and files over the same SSH connection.
Dialog.SftpDescription: File transfers over the SSH connection.
Dialog.FtpsDescription: FTP with explicit TLS. The default port is 21.
Dialog.HostExampleWithPort: E.g. 203.0.113.10 or server.example.com. Enter the port in its separate field.
Dialog.PrivateKeyHint: This field is the path to a private-key file, not a password. Leave it empty to use the VPS password; you will be asked when connecting.
Dialog.TimeoutHint: From 1 to 300 seconds. Includes authentication and server identity confirmation.
Dialog.ManualHint: Connect now or save a VPS to access it later.
Dialog.ManualHost: Manual connection IP address or domain
Dialog.OptionalNameHint: A name to find this VPS later. E.g. my-vps
Dialog.OptionalName: Name to save the VPS, optional
Dialog.OptionalKeyHint: Path to a private-key file, not a password. Leave this field empty to use the VPS password; you will be asked when connecting.
Dialog.SaveWithoutConnectHint: Save the VPS details without starting a connection.
Dialog.ConnectHint: Connect to the server using the details entered.
Dialog.CopyIpHint: Copy the server address without the username or port.
Dialog.KeySelectedHint: A private-key file is selected. Enter the password that protects this file, not the VPS password. Leave it empty for an unencrypted key.
Dialog.RevealHint: Confirm your current Windows account password to reveal this secret temporarily.
Dialog.CopySecretHint: Confirm your current Windows account password before copying. The app clears its clipboard entry after 30 seconds.
Dialog.WindowsPasswordHint: Your Windows account password is required to show or copy this secret. Windows PIN and biometric sign-in are not supported here.
Dialog.StorageHint: Only non-secret connection settings belong in a profile. Connection passwords and private-key passwords stay separate.
Dialog.VerifyServerHint: This server is not trusted yet. Compare this fingerprint with one provided by your server administrator.
Dialog.ReplaceHint: The current file will be preserved until the transfer finishes successfully.
Dialog.ReplaceRemote: A file with this name already exists on the VPS. Confirm to replace it.
Dialog.ReplaceLocal: A file with this name already exists on this computer. Confirm to replace it.
Dialog.PauseQueueHint: Pause the start of the next files. The current transfer continues.
Dialog.CancelAllHint: Cancel pending files and request cancellation of the current transfer.
Dialog.ClearCompletedHint: Remove only successfully completed transfers from the list.
Dialog.RetryHint: Connect to the same VPS to retry this operation. The destination will be checked again before overwriting.
Dialog.ShowFileHint: Select the downloaded file in File Explorer
Dialog.OpenFolderHint: Open the local folder of the uploaded file
Dialog.FailureDetailsHint: View failure reason and suggested action
Dialog.DropFiles: Drop to add files to the queue
Dialog.DropFilesHint: Files will be uploaded one at a time to the current remote folder.
Dialog.ValidationNameRequired: Enter a name to identify the VPS or server.
Dialog.ValidationName: Use a name of up to 100 characters without line breaks or control characters.
Dialog.ValidationHostRequired: Enter the server hostname or IP address.
Dialog.ValidationHost: Use only the hostname or IP address, without a protocol, username or path.
Dialog.ValidationIpv6: Use brackets only around a valid IPv6 address, without the port.
Dialog.ValidationSeparatePort: Enter the port in the Port field, separately from the server address.
Dialog.ValidationDomain: Enter a valid IP address or domain, such as server.example.com.
Dialog.ValidationTimeout: Enter a connection timeout between 1 and 300 seconds.
Dialog.ValidationUsername: Use a username of up to 128 characters without spaces, line breaks or control characters.
Dialog.ValidationGroup: Use a group of up to 80 characters without line breaks or control characters.
Dialog.ValidationKeyPath: Enter the key path on a single line without control characters.
Dialog.TemporaryCredentials: Manual connection credentials are temporary. Save a VPS profile to remember credentials.
Dialog.ClipboardUnavailable: The clipboard is unavailable. Try copying again.
Dialog.ConfirmWindows: Confirm your Windows account password in the system dialog.
Dialog.ConfirmCopy: Confirm your Windows password to copy the SSH secret.
Dialog.ConfirmReveal: Confirm your Windows password to reveal the SSH secret.
Dialog.VerificationCanceled: Windows authentication was canceled. The secret stays hidden.
Dialog.VerificationRejected: Windows authentication failed. Use the password of the current Windows account.
Dialog.VerificationUnavailable: Windows password verification is unavailable. The secret stays hidden.
Dialog.VerificationInactive: Return to this window and authenticate again. The secret stays hidden.
Dialog.SecretCopied: Secret copied. This app's clipboard entry will be cleared after 30 seconds.
Dialog.SecretRevealed: Secret shown temporarily. It hides after 15 seconds or when this window loses focus.
Dialog.CopyUnconfirmed: The copy could not be confirmed. Any clipboard entry created by this app is still scheduled for cleanup.
Dialog.ProtectedActionFailed: The protected action could not be completed. The secret stays hidden.
Dialog.RemoveConnectionQuestion:
Remove connection “{0}”?

The server files will not be changed.
Dialog.DownloadFolder: Choose a folder for downloaded files
Dialog.LocalWindowsVerificationMessage:
{0}

Enter the local Windows password for {1}. Use the password for this account on this computer, not a Microsoft account password or the SSH/VPS password.
